comments.body_html: you set per map bot limit. then the bot count is going to be a range between botCountMultiplierMin and Max. depending on the map youre on, getting 7-8 is very likely and expected.

comments.author: lumurkfox
comments.body_html:
1. This is how many waves of bots are going to spawn throughout the time of the raid. Setting this to 3 waves in a 20 minute raid will have one at the start, the next wave will be 1/3 of the way through and the last wave will be 2/3 of the way through.
  2. Bots are replaced each wave. The BotCountMultiplier Min and Max are the values used to give a range so its not a static number of bots each raid. Setting these to 1 and 1.5 will have a random bot max from the per-map default bot limit. So lets say youre on Customs. You have min at 1 and max at 1.5 . The default value of bots for Customs is like 19 or something. Each time you start a Customs raid, you will get a anywhere between 19 and 28 bots.
  3. I believe under Boss spawns, but idk for sure. havent really tested this specifically.

Your special request: maybe. ill look into it. its a lot to add in because itll be global settings. having it per map would tedious and this is just a hobby i do on the side because I like SPT. the normal boss spawn % is good enough for me and I’m just sharing my work in case others want to use it too.
